policy: One existing C procbench round per ordinary exclusive lock. Normal ASLR, no padding/smaps sampling/pause,CPU2 per child. Backend external counters disabled; its own PMU output captured. Exact kernel+user counter scope for other cases; positive nonmultiplexed counters and all child statuses zero required. One common harness parent per round. Cases execute grouped runs; all six role permutations balance position/predecessor role, but are not a causal isolation of all carryover. Analyze six clusters.
wrapper: No env exec wrapper. Child wall starts at release to exec rather than including fork, a distinct protocol from time-runs. Every capture and row retained.
transport: One complete tar stream per successful round includes rows, captured backend/large-ASM output, explicit harness exit and post-run compiler identities. Every child status and counter must still be verified separately.
